verdict.rationale: Pika says it generates clips up to 30-second multi-shot videos and turns a premise into a scripted, storyboarded film (pika-docs-1, pika-docs-19, pika-docs-45). For iteration, it documents several ways to rework an existing clip rather than regenerating it: extending from the final frame, painting a region and describing an edit, swapping elements, reshooting from a new angle, and reusing saved characters (pika-docs-41, pika-docs-48, pika-docs-47, pika-docs-50, pika-docs-43). Missing for 10: an explicitly named plain text-to-video flow (it is only implied via 'generate anything' and the premise-to-film app), prompt-level revision or version history of a generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
